services.name: Jiu Jitsu
services.desc: When parents hear Kids MMA, they sometimes picture the MMA they see on TV. But a quality youth MMA program is very different. Kids MMA is about giving children a well-rounded martial arts education by combining two highly effective disciplines: Jiu-Jitsu and Kickboxing. At High Altitude Martial Arts, kids learn age-appropriate techniques in a structured environment focused on confidence, discipline, fitness, and having fun. MMA stands for Mixed Martial Arts. Instead of training in only one martial art, students develop skills in multiple areas.
